en.body:
HONDVO Technology (Dongguan) Co., Ltd. has successfully passed the annual surveillance audit of its ISO 13485 medical device quality management system. The audit covered the full injection molding production process, including raw material incoming inspection, process control, cleanroom environment monitoring, traceability and final release.

The auditor reviewed documented procedures, production records and calibration files, and conducted on-site interviews with process owners. No major non-conformities were raised. The result confirms that HONDVO's quality system continues to meet the requirements of ISO 13485 and remains ready to support medical device customers in regulated markets.

HONDVO will continue to invest in process validation, Cpk/Ppk capability monitoring and operator training to keep the system effective and audit-ready at all times.
en.summary: HONDVO Technology has successfully passed the ISO 13485 medical device quality management system annual surveillance audit, covering the entire injection molding production process.
en.title: HONDVO Technology Passed ISO 13485 Annual Surveillance Audit

zh.body:

审核组查阅了程序文件、生产记录与校准档案，并与各工序负责人进行了现场访谈，未发现严重不符合项。审核结果证明弘欧的质量体系持续满足 ISO 13485 要求，能够稳定支持受监管市场的医疗器械客户。

弘欧将持续投入工艺验证、Cpk/Ppk 过程能力监控与人员培训，确保体系长期有效、随时可接受审核。

en.body:
To meet growing order volumes from medical device customers, HONDVO has installed two new TOYO CS-230 all-electric injection molding machines. Both machines are now in production inside the Class 100,000 cleanroom.

All-electric molding brings lower contamination risk, higher repeatability and better energy efficiency compared with hydraulic equipment. The new machines will be dedicated to high-precision components such as infusion parts, syringe components and IVD consumables, where dimensional stability and clean appearance are critical.

Each machine has been qualified under HONDVO's IQ/OQ/PQ program before release, with installation records, process window definition and three-batch performance validation archived for traceability.
en.summary: To meet the growing order demands from medical device clients, the company has introduced two new Japanese TOYO CS-230 all-electric injection machines, now officially operating in the Class 100,000 cleanroom.
en.title: Two New TOYO CS-230 All-Electric Injection Machines Put into Production

zh.body:
为满足医疗器械客户持续增长的订单需求，弘欧新引进两台日本 TOYO CS-230 全电动注塑机，目前已在十万级洁净车间正式投产。

相比液压机型，全电动注塑具有污染风险更低、重复性更好、能耗更优的特点。新设备将主要承担输液部件、注射器零件与体外诊断耗材等高精度产品的生产，保障尺寸稳定性与外观洁净度。

两台设备均已完成 IQ/OQ/PQ 验证后放行，安装记录、工艺窗口确认与三批次性能验证资料全部归档，确保全过程可追溯。

en.body:
HONDVO Technology and HONDVO Tooling showcased their medical molding capabilities at CMEF 2026, one of the largest medical equipment exhibitions in Asia.

The booth highlighted precision injection components for infusion therapy, enteral nutrition, IVD sampling and respiratory care, together with examples of medical-grade tooling. Visitors from Europe, North America and Southeast Asia showed particular interest in HONDVO's ability to combine mold development and volume molding under one quality system.

The event provided valuable face-to-face time with existing partners and new prospects. Discussions focused on design-for-manufacturing support, regulatory documentation and long-term capacity planning for 2027.
en.summary: HONDVO Technology showcased its core products including enteral nutrition infusion systems and injection drug delivery systems at CMEF 2026, reaching cooperation intentions with multiple domestic and international medical device companies.
en.title: HONDVO Showcases at CMEF 2026 China International Medical Equipment Fair

zh.body:
弘欧科技与弘欧模具共同参加了亚洲规模最大的医疗器械展会之一——2026 中国国际医疗器械博览会（CMEF）。

展台重点展示了面向输液治疗、肠内营养、体外诊断采样与呼吸治疗的精密注塑件，以及医疗级模具案例。来自欧洲、北美与东南亚的客户对弘欧"模具开发与批量注塑在同一质量体系内完成"的能力表现出浓厚兴趣。

展会期间，团队与老客户及潜在客户进行了深入交流，话题集中在可制造性设计支持、法规文件准备以及 2027 年的长期产能规划。
zh.summary: 弘欧科技携肠内营养输注系统、注射给药系统等核心产品亮相 CMEF 2026，与多家国内外医疗器械企业达成合作意向。

en.body:
The Swiss-made Hauser S35 jig grinder has completed installation and commissioning at HONDVO Tooling. The machine extends the company's capability in high-precision cavity finishing and post-machining correction.

With positioning accuracy at the micron level, the Hauser S35 is used for critical mold components where cavity tolerance and surface finish directly affect the quality of molded medical parts. It strengthens HONDVO's in-house ability to handle complex core inserts, electrode fitting and fine surface correction without outsourcing.

The equipment was accepted against agreed acceptance criteria and entered the preventive maintenance and calibration schedule from day one.
en.summary: The Hauser S35 jig grinder with 0.001mm precision has completed installation and commissioning in the mold workshop, further enhancing precision mold manufacturing capabilities.
en.title: Swiss Hauser S35 Jig Grinder Installation & Commissioning Completed

该设备定位精度达到微米级，主要用于型腔公差与表面质量直接影响注塑件品质的关键模具零件，使弘欧能够在内部完成复杂型芯镶件、电极配作与精细表面修正，无需外协。

HONDVO Tooling successfully passed the recertification audit of its automotive quality management system. The audit confirmed the effectiveness of the company's process controls, change management and continuous improvement mechanisms.

Although HONDVO's website now focuses on medical device manufacturing, the automotive-grade disciplines developed through IATF 16949 — structured problem solving, layered process audits and rigorous traceability — continue to benefit medical mold projects. The recertification is an internal capability milestone rather than a change in the website's stated scope, which remains centered on Class II medical device components and precision molds.

en.body:
HONDVO's Class 100,000 injection molding cleanroom passed the annual on-site audit conducted by an international medical device client.

The client reviewed environmental monitoring records, personnel and material flow, cleaning and sanitation procedures, and in-process controls. Particular attention was paid to particle counts, temperature and humidity trends, and the separation of molded parts from non-clean areas.

No major findings were raised. The audit outcome supports continued supply of cleanroom-molded components for the client's regulated product lines and reflects HONDVO's commitment to maintaining a controlled production environment.
en.summary: The Class 100,000 cleanroom successfully passed the annual on-site audit by a European medical device client, covering cleanliness control, SOP compliance, and batch traceability. Achieved excellent assessment with zero corrective actions required.

en.body:
A new German-made RODERS high-speed machining center has been delivered to HONDVO's mold center, expanding capacity for precision cavity machining and high-finish surface work.

High-speed machining allows finer surface finishes and shorter cycle times on complex mold geometries. Combined with the center's existing EDM and CMM equipment, the new machine shortens the route from rough machining to finished, inspected cavity.

The addition supports both medical mold projects and high-precision inserts used in volume injection molding, giving customers shorter lead times without relaxing dimensional or surface requirements.
en.summary: Following the Hauser S35 jig grinder, the mold center adds another major equipment — a German RODERS RXP 500 DCS high-speed machining center has completed installation and acceptance, achieving dual improvements in mold machining precision and efficiency.

zh.body:

高速加工能够在复杂模具几何上实现更细的表面粗糙度与更短的循环时间。配合模具中心现有的电火花与三坐标测量设备，新设备缩短了从粗加工到成品型腔检验的工艺路径。

该设备的加入同时服务于医疗模具项目与批量注塑所需的高精度镶件，帮助客户在不降低尺寸与表面要求的前提下缩短交期。

es.summary: Tras la rectificadora Hauser S35, el centro de moldes suma otro equipo de primer nivel: un centro de mecanizado de alta velocidad alemán RODERS RXP 500 DCS ha completado su instalación y aceptación, logrando una doble mejora en precisión y eficiencia de mecanizado de moldes.
es.title: Nuevo centro de mecanizado de alta velocidad alemán RODERS entregado al centro de moldes
es.body:
A new German-made RODERS high-speed machining center has been delivered to HONDVO's mold center, expanding capacity for precision cavity machining and high-finish surface work.

High-speed machining allows finer surface finishes and shorter cycle times on complex mold geometries. Combined with the center's existing EDM and CMM equipment, the new machine shortens the route from rough machining to finished, inspected cavity.

The addition supports both medical mold projects and high-precision inserts used in volume injection molding, giving customers shorter lead times without relaxing dimensional or surface requirements.
